Specification of Execution Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
Additional
Machine States
can be defined on a machine specific basis and are
therefore not standardized.
The
Execution Manifest
defines the relation between processes and
Function
Group States
. Therefore it is possible to determine the set of executed processes for
each
Function Group State
. A
Function Group State
is modeled by means
of
ModeDeclaration
, see [TPS_MANI_03145] and [TPS_MANI_03194].
In the API, a
Function Group
is represented by the class
ara::exec::Func-
tionGroup
, see [SWS_EM_02263] and a
Function Group State
by the class
ara::exec::FunctionGroupState
, see [SWS_EM_02269]. Class
ara::exec::
StateClient
performs state management during the lifetime of a
Machine
, see
[SWS_EM_02275].
Machine States
(as well as other
Function Group States
) are requested by
State Management
. The set of active states is significantly influenced by vehicle-
wide events and modes. For details on state change management see Section 7.5.5.
[SWS_EM_01032] Machine States configuration
⌈
Execution Management
shall
obtain the configuration of
Machine States
from
Function Group "MachineFG"
within the
SoftwareCluster
with category
PLATFORM_CORE
.

Scope of machine Function Group
⌈
The function-Group that represents the Machine Function Group group (see
[SWS_EM_CONSTR_02556]) shall only be referenced in the role claimedFunction-
Group by a
SoftwareCluster
of category
PLATFORM_CORE
.
⌋
(RS_EM_00101)
Please note that according to [constr_1788] there must be exactly one
Soft-
wareCluster
with category
PLATFORM_CORE
on each machine.
